jobs_results.title: Software engineer
jobs_results.description:
If your goal is saving the world, but you also think eating popcorn without taking your eyes off the screen is an elite training… Your place is here!

We are expanding our teams in the defence sector to take on ISR (Intelligence, surveillance intelligence and reconnaissance) projects.

We´ll get to the point; we'll tell you what's not on the web. If you want to know more about us go to GMV website

WHAT CHALLENGE WILL YOU BE TAKING ON?

In our team you will fully develop your skills as an engineer, being able to develop your experience in any of these fields:
• Requirements analysis and software model specification
• Architecture design of software solutions
• Development of software applications with different programming languages.

In short, participation in the different phases of the life cycle of a software project. All of this in a multinational framework and integrated in an agile development team.

WHAT DO WE NEED IN OUR TEAM?

For this position, we are looking for graduates... in Software Engineering or similar with a background and interest in object-oriented programming and all phases of the software lifecycle. High level of English

WHAT DO WE OFFER?

🕑 Hybrid working model and 8 weeks per year of teleworking outside your usual geographical area.

💻 Flexible start and finish times, and intensive working hours Fridays and in summer.

🚀 Personalized career plan development, training and language learning support.

🌍 National and international mobility. Do you come from another country? We can offer you a relocation package.

💰 Competitive compensation with ongoing reviews, flexible compensation and discount on brands.

💪Wellbeing program: Health, dental and accident insurance; free fruit and coffee, physical, mental and financialhealth training, and much more!

⚠️ In our recruitment processes you will always have telephone and personal contact, face-to-face or online, with our talent acquisition team. In addition, bank transfers and bank cards will never be requested. If you are contacted through any other process, please write to our team at privacy@gmv.com

❤️We promote equal opportunities in recruitment, and we are committed to inclusion and diversity.

WHAT ARE YOU WAITING FOR? JOIN US

If you have any questions please do not hesitate to contact Azahara Marcos Miguel, in charge of this vacancy.

Azahara Marcos Miguel

jobs_results.title: Senior Software Engineer - Data
jobs_results.description:
Why work at WWE

Inside Microsoft's Web Experiences Team 

The Bing Multimedia Team is at the heart of WebXT's mission to "Make the web work for you." Our vision is to empower users with the most engaging and personalized media search and recommendation experience. As a member of the Image Search Experience team, you'll play a pivotal role in optimizing the quality of image search results through User Experience. We're at the forefront of innovation, leveraging cutting-edge techniques in image understanding and Large Language Model technologies.

Responsibilities

Drive the development of user backend services and data pipelines for our Image Search platform.

Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to enhance user experience of our platform, aiming to make it more intuitive and efficient.

Integrate Language Model Models (LLM) into Image Search to enhance user interactions and ensure that our platform understands user intent better than ever before.

Collect and incorporate... user feedback to continuously improve the Image Search platform, addressing issues and adding new features based on user needs.

Stay up to date with the latest backend development technologies, tools, and trends to ensure our platform remains competitive and cutting-edge.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications:
• Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, or related technical discipline AND relevant years technical engineering experience with coding in languages including, but not limited to, C, C++, C#, Java, JavaScript, or Python
• Strong Experience of software design and development experience with backend services.

Preferred Qualifications
• Familiarity with Apache spark, Databricks, Azure HDInsights or Synapse or Azure ML systems is a plus. 
• Familiarity with ETL, Data Modeling, Data Engineering and past ML experience is a plus. 
• Experience building and managing highly scalable web services and Big Data systems. 
• Good grasp of System design and Patterns. 
• Good grasp of data structures, algorithms, programming patterns, and solving complex problems.   

#Search# #WWE#

Microsoft is an equal opportunity employer. Consistent with applicable law, all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, citizenship, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, immigration status, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran or military status, race, ethnicity, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable local laws, regulations and ordinances. If you need assistance and/or a reasonable accommodation due to a disability during the application process, read more about requesting accommodations

jobs_results.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs_results.description:
We are Kingmakers, a customer-centric tech startup, dedicated to creating innovative products that entertain our customers and keep them engaged both online and through our agency operations.

Since the successful launch of our first product, BetKing, in 2018, we have continued our momentum and will soon be introducing our newest offering, SuperSportBet, in South Africa. In partnership with the Multichoice Group and SuperSport, SuperSportBet enhances the passion that sports fans have for the game with a world-class sports betting and casino experience.

As our Kingdom expands, we proudly stand as the leading Sports and Digital Entertainment platform in Africa, and we are still actively hiring an exceptional team of Creators and Innovators across Africa, the United Kingdom, Europe, and the Middle East.

There has never been a better time to join our Kingdom than today!

What we would like you to do:

Have you ever thought of joining a company where your contribution to its product will... help redefine its position within its industry. We are one of the fastest growing companies in our sector, using innovative technology and solving the hardest problems to bring African sports fans unrivalled digital sports and gaming entertainment experiences, online, offline, 24/7.

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will be joining a team focused on ensuring that our gaming products are highly resilient, extremely low latency and scalable to massive volume, all while providing a first-class customer experience. You and your team will work hand-in-glove with the Product Managers to design, build, deliver and run our gaming platforms and products.

Part of our rapidly growing Tech team, you will have the opportunity to play a crucial role in taking the KingMakers products to the next level!

What you need for this role:
• In-depth knowledge of C# (.Net 7 preferably).
• In-depth knowledge of SQL (Azure Managed).
• Experience writing your own automated tests (Unit Tests or Integration).
• Experience working with containerization technologies (AKS/Kubernetes preferred).
• Practical experience working with messaging technologies (preferably Kafka)
• Good understanding of design patterns.
• Good understanding of architectural best practice (CI/CD, APM, SRE).
• Experience mentoring other engineers.
• A passion for detail and problem solving, with excellent verbal and written communication skills.

It would be great if you had experience with:
• Cloud-based technologies (preferably Azure).
• Working with NoSQL Technologies (Preferably MongoDB, ElasticSearch or CosmosDB).
• Infrastructure as code (Terraform).

How you do it – Expectations for fulfilling your role:

As a general rule, at KingMakers, we want people to be:
• Customer Focus: We keep the customer at the center of everything we do.
• Passion & Dedication: We are passionate about what we do, employing only smart, honest, dedicated, and results oriented team players.
• Openness, Honesty & Directness: We embrace a culture of candor and work together towards the right solution whilst being open, honest, and willing to give and receive feedback, judgment-free. We play the ball, not the person.
• Innovation & Big Thinking: We think like owners. If we see a problem, we find a solution. We are pragmatic and always strive to do more with less.
• Speed & Focus: We plan, we strategize, but mostly, we DO. Without doing there is no progress, we can always change direction but only if we start moving. Fast beats slow.
• Low Ego: The best solutions are achieved when we leave our egos at the door. We always seek opportunities to learn in every situation. No job is too small.
• Fun: On balance, we believe in having fun whilst working. We maintain perspective as best as we can, and together, we celebrate our successes.

Beyond our great company benefits and competitive salaries, we recognize that to grow sustainably and thrive positively we need to engage the right talent because our people are a merit to our success. We have an inclusive culture where everyone can thrive and where everybody has a seat at the table.

So, what are you waiting for? Click apply and join our Kingdom today

jobs_results.title: Becario de ingeniería de software
jobs_results.description:
Descripción del puesto

- Te incorporarás a ELCAdemy donde pasarás por una serie de formaciones y entrenamientos internos básicos e iniciales (Programación Orientada a Objetos con Java, Spring, SpringBoot, formación y prácticas SQL y formación frontend en Angular).

- Se te explicarán diferentes metodologías (Agile/Scrum).

- Aprenderás a trabajar en grupo y en un entorno internacional, aprenderás a gestionar y planificar tiempos, estimaciones, plazos, etc.

- Y lo más importante, una vez formado, al finalizar tu proceso ELCAdemy tendrás la posibilidad de tener un contrato indefinido y ser asignado a un proyecto final en la empresa.

Que ofrecemos?

-Jornada de 9 a 14 hs

-Practicas remuneradas

-Posibilidad de 1 dia de teletrabajo

-Programa desde el 17/06 al 15/11

Tecnologías que aprenderás

- Backend: Java, Spring, SpringBoot, Flyway, Mockito.

- Frontend: Angular, Typescript, NG-Zorro, Jasmine, Karma, NPM.

- BD: MySQL.

- CI/CD: Docker, Openshift.

- Control de versiones: GIT

... Gestión de proyectos: Atlassian Suite (Bitbucket, JIRA, Confluence).

- Programa de aprendizaje de habilidades blandas

Objetivos

- Aprender el desarrollo completo de una aplicación web (frontend + backend) en un entorno empresarial multinacional.

- Adquirir un conjunto de buenas prácticas para el desarrollo de software enfocado a la calidad.

- Obtener las habilidades adecuadas sobre cómo trabajar en el día a día en un proyecto real, con metodología Agile.

- Alcanzar el nivel adecuado de madurez y calidad para ser asignado a un proyecto internacional.

Conocimientos y habilidades

- Estar en el último curso de tu carrera universitaria

- Interés en formar parte de una empresa multinacional, líder en proyectos, productos y tecnología.

- Nivel mínimo de inglés: B2

- Y LO MÁS IMPORTANTE: Muchas ganas de aprender y crecer profesionalmente con nosotros.

Elca is committed to create a diverse and inclusive work environment, and proud to be an equal opportunity employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to their race, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or disability

jobs_results.title: INGENIERO/A SOFTWARE
jobs_results.description:
Formando parte del departamento de I+D, la persona realizará tareas de desarrollo de firmware en lenguaje de programación C para microcontroladores, así como el seguimiento y evolución de proyectos en desarrollo.

La persona se integrará en un equipo de desarrollo software dinámico, poco jerarquizado, en el que pueda explotar sus cualidades y tener una evolución profesional continuada en un entorno de “Mass Production” electrónico.

El tipo de firmware a desarrollar es cercano al hardware de microcontrolador y requiere que la persona tenga conocimientos asentados de electrónica. Esto le permite alcanzar un conocimiento global de la aplicación, no solamente restringido al software.

Mas que experiencia en desarrollo software, se busca un perfil que pueda encajar en el equipo de software y evolucionar dentro del departamento.

Se ofrece sólida carrera dentro de un entorno internacional de I+D avanzado tecnológicamente y posibilidades de evolución profesional dentro del área de la... electrónica.

Funciones

Desarrollo de software para microcontroladores en aplicaciones de inducción profesional.

Diseño del sistema de control del equipo teniendo en cuenta las normas de seguridad pertinentes, desarrollo y testeo del mismo para su posterior producción en serie.

Mantenimiento y apoyo a fábrica durante la vida útil del producto.

Desarrollo de software para microcontroladores.

Requisitos:
• Inglés
• Programación C

jobs_results.title: Ingeniero de Software
jobs_results.description:
Desde The Wise Seeker, buscamos un/a Ingeniero/a de software para nuestro cliente.

Funciones

Serás responsable de resolver múltiples retos dentro de la aplicación móvil y web. Tendrás la oportunidad de trabajar con un pequeño equipo de desarrollo para crear un producto mejor para nuestros clientes.
• Crear y mantener aplicaciones web y móviles para la organización, con énfasis en las aplicaciones móviles.
• Junto con el resto del equipo, garantizar que las aplicaciones se ajustan a los objetivos de la organización, así como a las necesidades de los clientes
• Supervisar el rendimiento de las aplicaciones para garantizar que siempre funcionan
• Mejorar el proceso general de desarrollo de aplicaciones
• Crear programas informáticos que respondan a necesidades específicas
• Implementar nuevas funciones que atraigan a nuestros usuarios y proporcionen una buena experiencia de aprendizaje
• Encontrar soluciones a amenazas de seguridad, virus o errores que puedan obstaculizar el... rendimiento de las aplicaciones
• Comprobaciones periódicas de seguridad y rendimiento
• Estar al día de las tendencias tecnológicas para mantener nuestro software lo más innovador posible
• Estar atento al ciclo de vida de la aplicación para garantizar que las actualizaciones necesarias se realizan a tiempo

Requisitos
• Experiencia como ingeniero de software
• Dominio de los principios de programación orientada a objetos en al menos un lenguaje como C# o Java. Estamos utilizando Dart/Flutter para nuestras aplicaciones móviles y web, por lo que la experiencia con Dart y Flutter es una ventaja.
• Conocimiento profundo de los principios básicos de programación, incluido el diseño
• Dominio Inglés - C1
• Capacidad de pensamiento crítico y analítico
• Atención al detalle
• Excelente gestión del tiempo
• Trabajo en equipo y habilidades de comunicación.

Beneficios
• 100% remoto
• Salario según valía del candidato

jobs_results.title: Software Engineer, Internship
jobs_results.description:
With 90 million active users and half a billion total downloads, Bending Spoons is one of Europe’s leading app developers. But we won’t rest on our laurels: Our sights are set on becoming the world’s best. That’s where you come in. Our bright, innovative, and collaborative software engineers are at the core of our ambitious mission—and we’re always seeking to add exceptional engineers to our team.

We’re searching for stand-out candidates who want to work in—and learn tons about—one of the following fields:
• Backend software engineering
• Data engineering
• Infrastructure engineering
• Mobile software engineering
• Security & privacy engineering

Don’t worry if you’re not sure what area you’d like to work in just yet: We can take the time to chat about your interests and work out what’s likely to be the best fit for you. And when you apply for a job at Bending Spoons, we consider you for every suitable open position.

Please note that our internships (both full- and part-time... require a minimum commitment of 12 months.

A few examples of your responsibilities:
• Work closely with other software engineers to expand our set of libraries and make our processes ever-more efficient.
• Learn about the latest and greatest technologies, testing the promising ones to make sure we don’t miss out on game-changing opportunities to boost our productivity and the enjoyment of our work.
• Constantly improve the quality of our products, tools, or infrastructures by fixing bugs and refactoring the code base where necessary.
• Contribute to product development and product roadmap planning. Take a proactive role and ownership of the products you work on.

What we look for
• Logical-analytical abilities. You’re able to objectively evaluate complex information, arguments, and situations. You’re used to applying logical deduction to tackle sophisticated problems, and this has often allowed you to solve difficult intellectual challenges.
• Drive. Your dedication matches the intensity of your ambition. You’re willing to put in the hard work necessary to achieve your goals, and the highly demanding challenges in your track record are proof of your relentless spirit.
• Passion. You have a genuine love for the field. You investigate the subject extensively and are always up to date with the latest developments.
• Willingness to learn. We use Python for backend, and Swift and Kotlin for mobile. But it's not a problem if you have little or no experience with them, as long as you’re enthusiastic about learning. We’d be happy to teach you!
• Proficiency in English. You read, write, and speak proficiently in English.
• You can work at least 25 hours per week. A full-time commitment is preferred, but we’ll consider applicants who can commit to around 25 hours per week.

What we offer
• An exceptional opportunity for growth. The majority of new Spooners didn’t expect to be trusted with so many responsibilities right from the start—and to be able to leverage them to explore the full extent of their potential. You’ll immediately start working in small, results-driven teams alongside some of the brightest people in your field. You’ll see Spooners in their 20s leading businesses worth hundreds of millions. And if you’ve got what it takes, you’ll soon be playing an essential role in major projects. We also do everything we can to offer a comprehensive spectrum of learning opportunities. Nothing but your drive, passion, and talent will determine how much and how fast you can grow.
• Unique engineering training. We pride ourselves on helping software engineers develop a well-rounded skill set: From time to time, you'll change projects and teams, broadening your skill set and helping keep things fresh. It’s a steep learning curve—we bet you can’t imagine how much you’ll have learned a year from now.
• All. These. Benefits. Flexible hours, unrestricted remote working from European timezones, unlimited backing for learning and training, top-of-the-market health insurance, a highly supportive relocation package, generous parental support, and yearly retreats to stunning locations. We encourage Spooners to use these benefits and many more to create the conditions to do their best work.
• Competitive salary and stock options. Our compensation packages are designed to attract and retain the best talent in the industry. Individuals just starting their career joining on a full-time contract are offered a salary of €63,965 along with a €1,200 welfare bonus. If you already have a few years of relevant work experience, you can expect to earn between €105,737 and €143,330, depending on your expertise. Compensation can grow rapidly as the individual accumulates experience and translates it into greater and greater impact. You also have the option to receive some of your pay in company ownership (equity) at a discounted rate. Also, Italy grants individuals willing to relocate a 50% tax exemption on Italian-sourced income.

Commitment & contract

Fixed-term or internship. Full-time or part-time.

Location

Milan (Italy) or fully remote.

The selection process

If you successfully pass through our screening process, we’ll invite you to take on a few tests that assess how you approach and solve unfamiliar problems. If you’re successful there, we’ll invite you to take part in some interviews. We welcome applications in English and Italian.

Bending Spoons is an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer. We consider for employment all applicants and we provide reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities, which can be requested at accommodations-ext@bendingspoons.com.

Studies suggest that women tend not to apply for a job if their CV isn’t a perfect fit. Here, we look for talent and potential—not just experience and expertise. So if you like the role and think you could be awesome at it, go ahead and apply

jobs_results.title: Programador/a de Robots (H/M/X)
jobs_results.description:
Desde Manpower Engineering estamos trabajando con un importante cliente nacional para ampliar su departamento de programación. Nuestro cliente, proveedor oficial de importantes empresas del sector automotriz, está buscando Programadores/as de Robots (H/M/X) para unirse a su equipo en Barcelona.

¿Cuáles serán tus principales funciones?

🛠️ Programar y mantener sistemas de control de maquinaria utilizando Robots Kuka y Fanuc.

🔧 Colaborar en proyectos de soldadura por puntos, mastico, manipulación y configuración de equipos.

🔍 Resolver incidencias e intervenir en entornos productivos para garantizar la eficiencia del proceso.

Requisitos:

🔹 Experiencia mínima de 1 año en programación de Robots Kuka y/o Fanuc.

🎓 Certificación VASS 5 y VASS 6 (deseable).

🔩 Experiencia en soldadura por puntos, mastico, manipulación y configuración de equipos (deseable).

👥 Aptitudes para la comunicación efectiva y el trabajo en equipo.

🗂️ Organización y metodología en el trabajo.

🛠️... Capacidad para resolver incidencias y trabajar en entornos productivos de manera eficiente.

Ofrecemos:

💰 Salario competitivo, acorde a la experiencia y conocimientos aportados.

📈 Componente variable en función de resultados.

👩💼 Incorporación a un equipo joven y dinámico.

📚 Formación continua para el desarrollo profesional.

🏢 Estabilidad laboral en un entorno en crecimiento

jobs_results.title: Software Engineer - fresh graduate
jobs_results.description:
Job Description

We're building a modern application that brings a beautiful and convenient user experience to the world of enterprise software. We are looking for a Junior Software Engineer interested in innovative front-end or full-stack web development who will join us at Oracle NetSuite in Barcelona. The team is delivering key UI experiences in the product; we like to be the first team to use a new technology and to raise the quality bar. Our tech stack includes TypeScript, Preact, our design system, Java and Oracle DB.

We love quality, clean code and test automation.You will join a small, friendly, high-performing international team. At the same time, you will be a member of a large but close-knit CRM tribe spread across Spain, Czechia, Uruguay and US, so you will also work with, and have fun with engineers, product managers, designers and tech writers in Europe and the Americas.

What You Will Do

This role is for someone who wants to be involved with all phases of the... development process: specification, design, implementation, testing, and maintenance. In our teams, you will learn not only about the software, but also about the business and our customers, helping you become a well rounded individual. We'd like you to be passionate about clean code, quality, and SOLID principles. Our team ensures that all junior software engineers receive continuing education and code review mentorship daily. If you want to work in an agile environment with continuous integration and TDD practices, our team would be a phenomenal fit.

Job Requirements
• Computer Science degree (Science, Technology, Engineering, and Math).
• WFH model: hybrid, minimum 2 days in the office.
• Front-end coding skills: mandatory Javascript/ECMAScript; desired TypeScript, React, HTML, CSS.
• Back-end coding skills: mandatory any object-oriented language (e.g. Java, C#, Python, Kotlin); desired any unit testing framework.
• Intimate understanding of modern web applications and database-driven applications such as SQL. Optionally, knowledge or experience with ORM framework.
• Great problem-solving skills and the ability to abstract functional requirements and strong communication abilities in both technical and non-technical contexts.
• Analytical thinker who wants to work in a team environment and develop and grow their skills.
• Embodiment of our Values: Customer First, Collaboration, Innovation, and Integrity.
• Other desired skills: Git; any testing framework or methodology; any Agile methodology.

At Oracle, we don’t just respect differences—we celebrate them. We believe that innovation starts with inclusion and to create the future we need people with diverse backgrounds, perspectives, and abilities. That’s why we’re committed to creating a workplace where all kinds of people can do their best work. It’s when everyone’s voice is heard and valued that we’re inspired to go beyond what’s been done before.

https://www.oracle.com/corporate/careers/diversity-inclusion/

About Us

As a world leader in cloud solutions, Oracle uses tomorrow’s technology to tackle today’s problems. True innovation starts with diverse perspectives and various abilities and backgrounds.

When everyone’s voice is heard, we’re inspired to go beyond what’s been done before. It’s why we’re committed to expanding our inclusive workforce that promotes diverse insights and perspectives.

We’ve partnered with industry-leaders in almost every sector—and continue to thrive after 40+ years of change by operating with integrity.

Oracle careers open the door to global opportunities where work-life balance flourishes. We offer a highly competitive suite of employee benefits designed on the principles of parity and consistency. We put our people first with flexible medical, life insurance and retirement options. We also encourage employees to give back to their communities through our volunteer programs.

We’re committed to including people with disabilities at all stages of the employment process. If you require accessibility assistance or accommodation for a disability at any point, let us know by calling +1 888 404 2494, option one.

Disclaimer:

Oracle is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer*. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability and protected veterans’ status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Oracle will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records pursuant to applicable law.
• Which includes being a United States Affirmative Action Employer

jobs_results.title: Software Engineer
jobs_results.description:
Desde Astek Iberia, estamos buscando un Software Engineer para cooperar con nuestro partner líder en el sector B2B IT travel a nivel global.

Por supuesto, tendrás la oportunidad de crecer profesionalmente y estar rodeado de personas expertas en IT que te ayudarán a aprender mucho más. 💪

💪 Tu misión, si la aceptas…
• Desarrollar nuevas funcionalidades y las existentes en soluciones de pago conectadas a varias plataformas externas, en un entorno de Cloud y microservicios.

👀 ¿Quién eres?
• Una persona con buena actitud y ganas de aprender (muy importante)
• Un buen compañero para trabajar en equipo
• Un amante de los idiomas. Es necesario un inglés de alto nivel, y si hablas francés, ¡mejor aún!
• Un ingeniero con al menos 2-3 años de experiencia desarrollando con C++, que conozca y tenga algo de experiencia con Java.
• Alguien con conocimientos en base de datos NoSQL como MongoDB y SQL como SQL Server
• Una persona con sólidos conocimientos en OOD y patrones de Diseño, Agile... Methodology (Scrum/Kanban), SAFe (Scaled Agile Framework).

💼 ¿Quiénes somos?

Desde 2015, Astek Iberia acompaña a sus clientes en su desarrollo en toda España (Madrid, Barcelona, Valencia, País Vasco, Andalucía, Galicia, etc.).

Fue fundada en Francia en 1988, Astek es un actor global en ingeniería y consultoría tecnológica, presente en cinco continentes y 22 países. Con experiencia en una amplia gama de sectores industriales y de servicios, Astek es un socio esencial, apoya a sus clientes en un despliegue inteligente de sus productos y servicios, y en la implementación de su transformación digital.

Hoy en día somos más de 7.200 empleados, comprometidos cada día a promover la complementariedad entre las tecnologías digitales y la ingeniería de sistemas complejos.

Nuestro estilo es tener horarios flexibles y valorar mucho el bienestar de nuestros empleados.

¿Por qué unirte a nosotr@s?

🚀 Crecerás profesionalmente en una empresa en constante desarrollo y evolución

🏝️ Disfrutarás de 23 días de vacaciones (además de los festivos) que podrás elegir cuando desees

🌍 Te integrarás a nuestro equipo: diverso, multicultural y en constante crecimiento con una modalidad híbrida (50% remote) con un entorno internacional.

📚 Formaciones en las últimas herramientas y stacks tecnológicos.

…aunque te queda mucho por descubrir! 😄

☎️ ¿Nos encontramos? 📧

Si quieres participar en el proceso, aplica desde aquí adjuntando tu CV (en inglés) lo más detallado posible y te contaremos más.

¡Mientras más rápido mejor
